thread:
Erin L: Quick sync — we're coordinating a coordinated version roll across API/runtime/console/sdk this week. Target cutoff: Friday 18:00 PT. Goal is minor bumps for console + SDK (breaking? no), patch for API/runtime. Ping if any blockers. :calendar: 

Vikram: FYI runtime will need the small kv-cache flag change landed (PR: https://git.internal/runtime/pull/342). It's non-breaking but requires a config toggle. I can make the runtime default behave the old way until canary passes.

Maya: Console has a telemetry schema change that technically bumps minor. PR: https://git.internal/console/pull/178 — it's opt-in via env var, no UI break. Plan was 0.15.2 -> 0.16.0.

Sam: SDKs (js/python) currently at 1.4.0. There's a doc-only change + new retry param we added. We should keep them same minor as console? or patch? my PRs: https://git.internal/sdk-js/pull/501 and https://git.internal/sdk-py/pull/322

Jules: From QA: need at least one full e2e run with runtime canary + console opt-in before we cut tags. Can we schedule a canary window Thu 9–11am PT?

Erin L: Agreed on e2e. Vikram, can you enable default-old-behavior and flip for canary during Thu window? Then QA runs against canary. If canary is green, we flip and tag.

Vikram: Yep I can toggle the feature flag during that window. I’ll also add a compatibility test in runtime CI that exercises old kv-cache path.

Maya: Re changelog — I'm drafting notes but need the SDK param wording from Sam. Sam, can you add a short bullet and example code snippet in your PR description? e.g.:
```js
// new retry param
client = new Redwood({ retry: { maxAttempts: 3 } })
```

Sam: on it, done. Also added a quick migration note for users with custom timeouts.

Erin L: Okay timeline recap:
- Thu 09:00–11:00 PT: runtime canary + QA e2e
- Thu 16:00 PT: final thumbs for docs/changelogs (Maya + Sam)
- Fri 18:00 PT: cutoff for tag + release (I'll cut tags unless objection)

Jules: No objections from QA if we get green canary. I'll schedule the e2e and post results here.

release-bot: build/runtime-canary #342 deployed to canary at 2025-06-12T09:02:11Z :rocket:

Vikram: Canary flipped to new path for testing. Rolling back to old default on failure is scripted: `./scripts/rollback-canary.sh runtime`

Erin L: If no major regressions, I'll cut these tags Friday: `console@0.16.0`, `sdk-js@1.5.0`, `sdk-py@1.5.0`, `api@0.14.5`, `runtime@0.14.1`. If anyone needs a different versioning, speak now. :eyes:

Sam: 1.5.0 works for both SDKs. I'll open the release PRs and link changelog bullets.

Maya: Docs PR will target console 0.16.0 notes, linking SDK code sample.

Jules: I'll post e2e pass/fail here after Thu run. :crossed_fingers:

Erin L: Thanks team — small ask: please add any final commit/PR numbers to this thread so I can assemble the release checklist before tagging. If I don't hear objections, I'll proceed at the cutoff. :shipit:
